description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Differential Bearing Kit – LEVEL 1 – for the SJ413 / Suzuki Samurai 86-95
Fits the Front or Rear Differential
Quality Bearings made to Japanese Standards.
Puts Everything you Need to Complete the Install in One Affordable Kit!
Direct Replacement
Level 1 Kit Includes:
Bearings:
Qty 1 – Pinion (Inner) Bearing
Qty 1 – Outer Bearing
Qty 2 – Side Bearings
Oil Seal:
Qty 1 (Behind Flange)
Shims:
9pc Set – Varying Thickness
Nut:
Qty 1 – Pinion Nut
Spacer:
Qty 1 – Spacer Bevel Pinion
Marking Kit:
Qty 1 – Brush
Qty 1 – Paint (yellow)
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Level 1 Differential Kit (see above)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
